items.source: Creates new RunProcess instance for the specified working directory and command.
items.translation: 为指定的工作目录和命令创建新的RunProcess实例。

items.source: Creates new RunProcess instance for the specified command.
items.translation: 为指定的命令创建新的RunProcess实例。

items.source: command - the program to execute and its arguments
items.translation: command - 要执行的程序及其参数

items.source: Return if the process was stopped.
items.translation: 如果进程已停止，则返回。

items.source: workingDirectory - the working directory of the child process or null to run in the working directory of the current Java process
items.translation: workingDirectory - 子进程的当前工作目录，或为 null（表示在当前 Java 进程的工作目录中运行）

items.source: Phillip Webb, Dave Syer, Andy Wilkinson, Stephane Nicoll, Dmytro Nosan
items.translation: Phillip Webb, Dave Syer, Andy Wilkinson, Stephane Nicoll, Dmytro Nosan

items.source: Utility used to run a process.
items.translation: 用于运行进程的实用工具。
